notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
[b]The game has just received a major update![/b]

[i]Here's what awaits you within:[/i]

[list]
[*] Two new localizations: Korean and Japanese languages
[*] A new system for tracking found items in the easy mode, making progression even easier
[*] Official game walkthrough added to the Steam guides section

[i]As well as...[/i]


[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[*] Reduced time to skip the snake puzzle (new values: 3 and 5 minutes for each difficulty level respectively. Previously: 5 and 10 minutes)
[*] Updated visual hints for solving the zoo puzzle (easy mode)
[*] The custom mosaic from the bonus section is now always accessible without playing the main storyline
[*] The game works with new Steam SDK now


[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

[*] Fixed bugs with the snake puzzle
[/list]

notes.title: Update v. 1.0.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
One found major bug has been quickly fixed.

[b]Gameplay improvements[/b]
- fixed a bug where the 8th compartment becomes unavailable. 
[i](Bug: train is stopped and 8th compartment is not available. Bug occurs when player tries to enter 6th compartment after train stopping. Just visit an area with door to 6th compartment again. Game will fix it and you'll be able to visit the 8th compartment. If you don't have this bug you don't need to do these steps.)[/i]

[b]Improvements[/b]
- update cover image for bonus puzzles

tags.bug: - fixed a bug where the 8th compartment becomes unavailable.

notes.title: Update v. 1.0.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fortunately, no one bugs of the first version was found, but some cosmetic and gameplay improvements have already been made with this small patch.

[b]Gameplay improvements[/b]
- snake puzzle keeps a progress when closed
- added new hint for snake puzzle to easy mode

[b]UI fixes[/b]
- fix hint icons animation
